default.title: About Independent Baking Co.
default.content: Independent Baking Co. is a family-run artisan bakery in Portland, Oregon. We bake sourdough, croissants and seasonal pastries every morning and sell them at our shop and two farmers markets.

default.title: Visit us
default.content: Open Tuesday to Sunday, 7am to 3pm. Wholesale orders for cafes are available on request. Our bakery employs a small team of bakers and counter staff.
